notes: Early baseline runs did not independently count unexpected HTTP; only health readiness was initiated by harness.
Stage 8/9 suspend the collector scheduler after one real scheduled full collection; these show residual process CPU, not continued scheduler behavior.
Stage 9 first attempt produced successful actual forecast HTTP: 22 rows per array, 11 solar adjustment rows; its idle attempt was rejected on state-file error.
Stage 9 valid retry respected forecast reservation and skipped external request; replay produced 11 adjusted solar rows and 0 house-load rows, which may reflect reuse of existing daily forecast.

Actual no-browser, solar-options and stock reverse-order repeats have incomplete process-tree isolation: an owned worker persisted with no measurable CPU over a later five-second observation; server teardown timing was also not logged.
Clean stock and actual pair held process handles through shutdown, and both exited before the next stage.
cProfile thread timing is invalid; polling/actual traces contain negative timings and impossible self times. Counts are diagnostic only; profile control endpoints caused two expected HTTP requests.

Initial standalone DP attempt timed out at the five-second cap. After explicit user approval of a 120-second cap, one actual configured persistent-worker DP projection completed; its full report preceded a 31-second settle and valid 60-second idle window.

independent_cycle_diagnostic.scope: Event-loop callbacks measured with QueryThreadCycleTime; excludes native event-loop waits and other processes. Timestamp query cycles and elapsed time are measured separately within I/O threads. Instrumentation overhead is present. Cycles are not milliseconds or unprofiled CPU percentages.
